justification: Copy-only change to user-facing text in seven files. No logic, query, type or data change. Not above minor because no behaviour moves; the one import added (COVERAGE_DISPLAY in LandingHero) is an existing constant.

falsifiable_check.command: git diff origin/main -U0 | grep '^+' | grep -ciE 'verif[i]ed|applicable to your work|Fast-Track|Full NSW coverage|granny flat detection|Monitored weekly'
falsifiable_check.fails_when: Prints anything other than 0, meaning one of the old claims was re-added. Result on this branch: 0.
falsifiable_check.external_authority: railway.dcp-monitor.toml (cronSchedule 0 2 1,15 * *, fortnightly) for the check frequency; the timestamp column in instrument_currency, written by scripts/r2_monitor.py after a clean run (23 councils stamped 2026-10-15) for the last-check date; lib/coverage.ts for the council count (128); the 2026-08-10 detection-layer decision (recall 0.368 against a 0.70 floor on 56 human-labelled lots) for removing the detection wording.

pre_impl.existing_data: Reads instrument_currency timestamps and COVERAGE_DISPLAY.lgasCovered as before; no new read, no write.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The old text said Monitored weekly, but the monitor cron runs on the 1st and 15th of each month. The new text says fortnightly to match railway.dcp-monitor.toml. The 35-day staleness warning threshold is unchanged.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Text only, applies to every render.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: If the date of the last check is missing, the page shows Date of last check unavailable, as before in wording terms.

break_it.scenario: The new copy states something the data does not support.
break_it.what_happens: Same overclaim problem as the text it replaces.
break_it.how: Each new phrase was tied to a source: fortnightly check to railway.dcp-monitor.toml; last-check date to the instrument_currency timestamp; 128 councils to lib/coverage.ts; zoning live from the Planning Portal because the DCP layer is a dated extract.

break_it.scenario: Old claim wording is re-added in a later edit.
break_it.what_happens: Applicability, currency or detection overclaim returns.
break_it.how: Falsifiable check command greps added lines for the old phrases and prints 0. Liability word scan of added lines also gave 0 hits.
break_it.repro: git diff origin/main -U0 | grep '^+' | grep -ciE 'verif[i]ed|applicable to your work|Fast-Track|Full NSW coverage|granny flat detection|Monitored weekly'

break_it.scenario: Layout breaks because the new strings are longer.
break_it.what_happens: Text wraps or clips in the hero, data source strip or pathway card.
break_it.how: Not checked in a browser in this change; copy is longer in the hero and pathway card. tsc and jest do not cover layout.
break_it.repro: Open the landing page and an assessment result at phone width and read the changed lines.

mutation_analysis: Not applicable: no logic changed and no test was added. tsc --noEmit reports 0 errors; full jest 140 suites / 1973 tests pass.
residual_risk: The phrase every figure traced to its source is kept on purpose: it was approved in 2026-07 and each run carries a provenance footer (app/reports/intelligence-brief/provenance.ts). Whether to reword it is left for a separate decision. Layout at narrow widths is not checked. The audit of 2026-10-15 measured about 16 severe cases per 100 served rules, so the new wording reduces the claim but does not change the data.
